caveats.summary: Challenge 113 uses a production-only HAI settlement cap of 1 to bound the hacked asset's contribution by allocated margin; an accepted on-chain information entry supplies the corrected UPDOWN CID, and all publication and scoring checks pass exactly.

realized_return_overrides.basis: the unique full-rank return vector inferred from 44 published NEUTRAL gains and 42 on-chain UPDOWN rewards
realized_return_overrides.rationale: HAI's hack-related price dislocation was isolated by capping its settlement return at 1; with unit gross portfolio margin, this bounds the absolute HAI gain or loss by the margin allocated to HAI
